messages.text: which of these plants are humidity loving plants

Looking at your collection, these are your **humidity-loving plants**:

**High humidity preference (50-70%+):**
- **Prayer Plant** — loves humidity; benefits from misting or a pebble tray
- **Fittonia** — thrives in high humidity; will droop if air is too dry
- **Mini Orchid** — prefers 50-70% humidity (especially when blooming)
- **Both Terrariums** — self-contained humid environments, perfect for moisture-lovers

**Moderate-to-high humidity preference (40-60%):**
- **Monstera** (both regular and Thai Constellation) — tropical, appreciates humidity
- **Royal Ivy (English Ivy)** — does best with good humidity
- **Wandering Dude** — prefers moist air
- **All Pothos varieties** (Golden, Pearls & Jade, Mixed Combo, Marble Queen) — tolerate average humidity but appreciate higher
- **Philodendron 'Silver Stripe'** — tropical, benefits from humidity

**Notes for Austin:**
- Indoor humidity in Austin can drop to 30-40%, especially with AC running
- Group these plants together to create a microclimate
- Consider a small humidifier near the Prayer Plant and Fittonia
- Your succulents, cacti, Snake Plant, Aloe, ZZ, and Scheffleras are all low-humidity tolerant and fine in drier air

The Prayer Plant and Fittonia are your most humidity-dependent; watch them for crispy leaf edges as a sign of low humidity.
